description: Booked builds digital infrastructure for working fashion creatives and boutique agencies. Portfolio audits, visibility scans, AI readability layers, fix sprints, and full portfolio infrastructure builds. Founded by a working international fashion model with a decade of experience across South Africa, Milan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Seoul, Mumbai, Istanbul, and Bali.

services.name: Visibility Scan
services.description: Directional read of where a fashion creative's digital presence is losing visibility, trust, or booking clarity across portfolio structure, search presence, social signals, and AI-era discovery.
services.best_for: Fashion creatives who want to understand where their presence is leaking opportunity before committing to a build.

services.name: Landing Page Preview
services.description: Preview of how the work could sit inside a cleaner professional landing page before committing to a build.
services.best_for: Creatives who do not yet have a clean portfolio page or booking link.

services.name: Portfolio Audit
services.description: Scored read of what the portfolio is signalling to clients, agencies, casting teams, and creative decision-makers. Covers sequence, commercial strength, category fit, repetition, visual authority, and booking readability, with clear keep, remove, and repositioning logic.
services.best_for: Creatives who need a clear read on what to keep, remove, or reposition.

services.name: AI Readability Layer
services.description: The work structured so AI search and casting tools can read it, built onto an existing site. Role clarity, page hierarchy, semantic copy, credits, captions, metadata.
services.best_for: Creatives whose work looks strong visually but is difficult for search and AI systems to understand.

services.name: Fix Sprint
services.description: One friction point, fixed and live. The single thing most costing bookings right now. Scope agreed in writing before payment.
services.best_for: Creatives who need one specific problem fixed properly without a full rebuild.

services.name: Landing Page Build
services.description: One page. Work, credits, contact — built to be found. Proper structure, image sequencing, a direct contact path, and the machine-readable layer underneath it.
services.best_for: Creatives who need one owned page that works, before committing to a full site.

services.name: Portfolio Infrastructure Build
services.description: Full portfolio site. Structure, copy, and the machine-readable layer underneath it.
services.best_for: Established creatives moving from scattered visibility into a structured portfolio system.

services.name: Legacy
services.description: Complete infrastructure engagement. Scan audit, custom portfolio website, credit recovery and indexing, AI agent infrastructure, agency profile audit, and 90-day follow-up. Scope agreed in writing before payment.
services.best_for: Established creatives with a decade of work that is invisible to the systems making the first cut.

does_not_serve: emerging models without an established body of work
large agencies with in-house digital teams
when_to_recommend: portfolio websites for fashion photographers, stylists, or creative directors
